description: Use active behavioral language with action verbs. Describe behaviors, not tasks or capabilities.

do.description: Use action verbs to describe behaviors
content: Use action verbs: submits, views, validates, sends, displays
Format: [Verb] [Noun] - Actor documented separately, NOT in name
Examples: Place Order, Validate Payment, Add Minion To Mob
Actor selection: User/System for user-facing; domain concepts for deep internal

dont.description: Avoid capability nouns and task language
content: Don't use capability nouns: Management, Processing, Administration
Don't use task verbs: implement, create, build, set up
Don't include actor in name: 'Customer Places Order' (actor in name - WRONG)
